newsitem.title: USA: Law firm says files action vs WebSecure.
newsitem.headline: Law firm says files action vs WebSecure.

text.p: A suit seeking class action status was filed Wednesday against WebSecure Inc, lawyers for the plaintiffs said.

The suit was filed on behalf of those who bought common stock or redeemable common stock purchase warrants of WebSecure in the initial public offering or thereafter between December 5, 1996 and February 27, 1997, the law firm of Wolf Popper Llp said.
The suit was filed in United States District Court for the District of Massachusetts.
The complaint alleges that in its initial public offering commenced on December 5, 1996, WebSecure filed a registration statement with the SEC that contained false information.
No one from WebSecure Inc was available for comment.
